summary: Attribute the native agents-list request to roster admission, blocking and reader admission, caches, card reduction and local overlays using existing opt-in operation profiling.

replay.detail: No claim or projection computation change.

rules.detail: No authority or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: The list, filters, pagination and full card remain unchanged. Only bounded labels in existing opt-in profile records are added.

downtime.detail: No new daemon activation or mandatory restart mechanism. Deployment follows the ordinary binary rollout.

manual.detail: Existing ST3_PROFILE_DIR controls profiling. No new collector or profiling setting.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries ignore these new profile phase labels. No data migration or certificate change.
